items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and flaky.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to soften the look of flakiness and support a comfortable skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily morning use, since skin can be more sun-sensitive while you are on isotretinoin.

response.routine_note: Because you mentioned isotretinoin, I left out the wax strips, glycolic toner and vitamin C serum, as they can be too harsh on dry, flaky skin, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about safe hair removal and about the flaking. Cleanse gently morning and night, apply the cream after cleansing, and finish with the SPF in the morning.
